name: career-compass
description: Job-search co-pilot. Paste a job posting to see how well you fit, then tailor your résumé, prep the interview, and weigh the offer. In Claude Code and Cowork it also remembers your career history and tracks every application, as plain YAML on your own computer.

data_path.title: Career data folder
data_path.description: Where your career history and job pipeline are kept, as plain YAML on this computer. Nothing is uploaded. Leave the default unless you want it somewhere specific, such as inside a folder you already back up.
